 Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes for October 2026
 How to redeem Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes in Roblox.
 Image credit: Ragdoll Physics Experiences 
 Guide
 by Dion Dassanayake 
 Contributing Guides Writer
Updated on Oct. 31, 2026, 11:24 a.m. 
 Follow Ragdoll Robot Boxing
Prioritise us on Google 
 Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes will help you claim free Spins and Gears, which you can use to unlock new Robots in the Roblox fighting game. The experience is a bit like a cross between Untitled Boxing Game and the hit 90s TV series Robot Wars. If you're too young for that reference, you may be more familiar with The Simpsons episode that's based on the show!
 Players take control of a robot, and battle it out with another bot in the ring, trying to knock them down until they can't get up anymore. I've played a lot of Roblox boxing games, and this one is really easy to get into, which helps make it feel rewarding straight away. If you find yourself struggling to win a bout though, you can always redeem codes for Ragdoll Robot Boxing so you can get free Spins and Gears, which will help you unlock more powerful Robots to use. Codes are shared in the game's Discord server , but we've rounded up all the latest codes below so you can just focus on winning matches!

 All working Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes
 Here are all the working Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes as of 31st October 2026:

 ROBOTBOXING - 500 Gears

 HEAVYMETAL - 2 Spins 
 SCRAPJAW - 1 Lucky Spin 
 How to redeem codes in Ragdoll Robot Boxing
 Redeeming codes in Ragdoll Robot Boxing is nice and easy. Here's a step-by-step guide on how to do it:
 Launch Ragdoll Robot Boxing in Roblox.
 Select the 'Codes' button on the left of your screen. 
 Image credit: Eurogamer/Ragdoll Physics Experiences 
 Type a code into the text box and then press 'Redeem'. 
 Image credit: Eurogamer/Ragdoll Physics Experiences
